dataset_info.notes: CLINC150 (Larson et al. 2019) — 150 in-scope intents across 10 domains, English, plus an explicit out-of-scope class. Absorbed from ovos-intent-benchmark's dataset list. Uses the 'plus' config, whose 1000 out-of-scope test utterances are tagged bucket='far_ood' with expected_intent=None so the scorer treats a non-fire as correct — a genuine 'don't guess' regression test the other 3 absorbed corpora don't provide.
